title: Traded-Vehicle Cancellation Fee and the Holder's Standing — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
**Rule.** For a traded-vehicle refund on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the cancellation fee follows the holder's standing with the group. The fee is the first of the following that applies:
1. **No fee.** No fee is taken where the contract's latest denied component-repair line was later paid as a component-repair line on the same claim number, repair order and component group. "Latest" is by decision date; on a same-day tie, it is the one that appears first in the claim history. A paid line entered on or after the day of that denial counts as later.
2. **Trade loyalty fee.** Where that is not so, and the holder holds a Kessler Owner Rewards Silver, Gold or Platinum service account in active status, the trade loyalty fee of 25.00 is taken. The account is read from the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.
3. **Coverage level's fee.** Otherwise, the coverage level's cancellation fee is taken.

| Coverage level | Coverage level's cancellation fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Kessler Shield Powertrain | 75.00 |
| Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus | 75.00 |
| Kessler Shield Select | 75.00 |
| Kessler Shield Preferred | 50.00 |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary | 50.00 |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap | 50.00 |

**Cases (hypothetical, Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus).**

| Latest denied component-repair line | Service account | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Paid on the same claim number, repair order and group, on or after the denial day | any | 0.00 |
| Never paid that way | Kessler Owner Rewards Gold, active | 25.00 |
| Never paid that way | Kessler Owner Rewards Silver, closed | 75.00 |
| Never paid that way | Service Guest Account | 75.00 |
